snippet.title: Swish and Flick: Tidy Up Together – Trailer [English]
snippet.description:
A wizard duel has wrecked the wand shop: thousands of magical objects lie scattered across its rooms. Sort wands, potions, runes and candles back where they belong, cast tidying spells, and watch every room wake up in a burst of magic. Play solo or with up to three friends.

Out December 18, 2026 on Steam, for PC.
Add it to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5392270/

X: https://x.com/SwishFlickGame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/swishandflick.game
